properties.title: Hazardous Operations
properties.body:
[Gulf of Finland] ESTONIAN NAV WARN 190/26
GULF OF FINLAND.
250700-251000 UTC NOV.
W OF NAISSAAR ISLAND.
FIRING PRACTICE AREA 2A
CENTRED 59-35.0N 024-19.0E
FIRING EXERCISES IN PROGRESS.
OTHER VESSELS MUST AVOID
ENTRY INTO THE AREA.
STANDING BY VHF CH 13 AND 61.
CANCEL 251000 UTC NOV.
